notes: Manual anime->manga links. Keys are anime ids (strings), values are lists of qualified manga slugs: bare 'NNNN--slug' (MangaLib), 'remanga:<dir>' (Remanga), 'readmanga:<linkName>' (ReadManga). 'links' entries always win over auto-matches; 'exclude' slugs are removed from auto-matches. Curated 2026-11-25 from live top-50 refresh audit: every excluded slug was verified a wrong work (parody/fanfic 'yumiko_honda' One-Punch-Man doujinshi, 'berserkir' parody, Persona 3 manga for Persona 4/5 anime, Naruto Shinden novel-entry for Shippuden, 'vse_sezony_' season compilations, Disgaea 2 for the Disgaea 1 anime, Reze fan one-shot for the Reze movie, 'love_mate_2' alt-name collision for Suzuka, 'mstitel_09' for REVENGER, 'familia' short-string collision). No invented links: anything without a verified source stays unresolved in link_report.json.
